RMCC Thursday Night Climbing

Golden, CO · Lookout Mountain · Road

RMCC Thursday Night Climbing is a road group ride in Golden, CO. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Beverly Heights Park, base of Lookout Mountain.

For visitors

Lights are required as the days shorten; descents can be at dusk. Sign in on Meetup.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: climbing ride; riders who can do Lookout solo in about 30 minutes can rejoin at the regroups. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the RMCC Thursday Night Climbing group ride

A long-running Thursday-evening climbing ride up Lookout Mountain, with Genesee, Montane, Lininger and other climbs added as daylight allows. It is a drop-and-regroup ride: the club says riders have been dropped on the first climb, and 3 w/kg is a good starting point.
